title: Kernel-Based LMI Approaches to Solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Equation and Nonlinear Optimal Control
summary: We present a kernel-based linear matrix inequality (LMI) approach for the approximate solution of Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equations arising in nonlinear optimal control. The method represents the gradient of the value function in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) and uses a Schur-complement reformulation to convert the quadratic HJB inequality into an LMI that is linear in the kernel coefficients, yielding a convex semidefinite program.
